title: God Didn't Design You to Search This Hard for a Wife
caption:
Somewhere between Proverbs and the app store, finding a wife turned into hunting one.

Proverbs 18:22 says whoever finds a wife finds a good thing. A find is what happens to a man doing something else with his life. The chase happens to a man who's stopped.

Build a life worth being found in.

#faith #proverbs #christianmen #dating #manofgod
theme: He chases God, not a wife.
